verdict: AMD's revenue rose 18% to $6.8B — its best quarter yet — as Data Center sales more than doubled on AI demand, and with gross margin back to 50%, net income more than doubled to $771M.

segments.name: Data Center
segments.note: EPYC server processors and Instinct AI accelerators — revenue more than doubled to a record $3.5B on the Instinct GPU ramp and EPYC share gains.

segments.name: Client
segments.note: Ryzen processors for PCs — up 29% on strong demand for 'Zen 5' desktop chips.

segments.name: Gaming
segments.note: Graphics cards and console chips — down 69% as semi-custom console revenue fell late in the console cycle.

segments.name: Embedded
segments.note: Chips built into cars, industrial gear and communications equipment (the Xilinx business) — down 25% as customers worked through their inventories.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Designing the next generations of CPUs, GPUs and AI accelerators.

opex.name: Marketing, general & administrative
opex.note: Selling products and running the company.

opex.name: Amortization of intangibles
opex.note: Writing down the value of technology bought in acquisitions (Xilinx above all) — a bookkeeping charge, not cash — shown net of a $14M licensing gain.

otherDetail: Other income of $36M, plus $7M of equity income from an investee, less $23M of interest expense — a net +$20M.
footerNote: Cost of sales of $3,400M includes $233M of amortization of acquisition-related intangibles, following AMD's own presentation of its income statement. The amortization line in operating expenses is shown as $338M — AMD's $352M of amortization net of a $14M licensing gain. The tax line was a small $27M benefit, drawn as a green source into net profit.

takeaways.title: Data Center more than doubled
takeaways.text: Data Center revenue hit a record $3.5B, up 122% YoY, on the ramp of Instinct AI GPUs and EPYC server CPUs — it is now more than half of everything AMD sells.

takeaways.title: Margins healed
takeaways.text: Gross margin reached 50%, up from 47% a year ago, as high-margin data-center chips became the mix — operating income more than tripled to $724M and net income reached $771M.

takeaways.title: Gaming and Embedded still shrinking
takeaways.text: Gaming revenue fell 69% to $462M late in the console cycle and Embedded fell 25% as customers digested inventories — together they masked how fast the AI-driven businesses are growing.
